title: `AnimationNodeTransition` is calling property keyframes every frame
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.4.stable.mono.official [4c311cbee], v4.5.rc2.mono.official [2dd26a027], v4.3.stable.mono.official [77dcf97d8] ### System information ArchLinux, v4.5.rc2.mono.official [2dd26a027], RX 7800XT, AMD Ryzen5 7600 ### Issue description I expect my animations to play their property keyframes only when they are reached in animation. For some reason in my project it calls them every frame when used with an `AnimationNodeTransition` ### Steps to reproduce Create an `AnimationTree` with `AnimationNodeBlendTree` as the `tree_root`. Add an `AnimationNodeAnimation` node and an `AnimationNodeTransition`. Create one input for `AnimationNodeTransition` and plug the `AnimationNodeAnimation` output into the input. Connect the output for the `AnimationNodeTransition` to the output for the `AnimationNodeBlendTree`. Create a script for the `AnimationTree` with a boolean export that does something on set, such as `print("hello")` ``` extends AnimationTree @export var test : bool = true: set(value): test = value print("test bool set") ``` On the `AnimationTree` create a new `Animation`. Add a property keyframe for this new `Animation` that sets the boolean on the `AnimationTree` to any value. Set `AnimationNodeAnimation.animation` to this new `Animation`. Set `AnimationNodeTransition` to the only available `AnimationNodeAnimation`. Set this scene as main, run the project. You will see the logic inside the boolean setter called repeatedly, I am not sure if it is every physics frame or every process frame. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [reset-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22797449/reset-bug.zip)
